name: Medium-voltage distribution (11 kV and 33 kV)
principle: Malaysia's MV distribution levels: TNB supplies 11 kV for roughly 1,000-5,000 kVA and 33 kV up to about 25,000 kVA (22 kV appears in parts of Johor and Perak). At site level an intake substation receives the supply and ring-main units feed substation transformers, often with redundant transformers and an N+1 scheme for critical process loads. MV installations carry the highest periodic-inspection frequency under the Electricity Regulations.

costs.metric: indicative cost, 12-24 kV SF6 ring main unit, unit
costs.basis: Export price list (accepted price basis, owner instruction 2026-11-13): compact SF6 RMUs about USD 2,000-2,700, mainstream 12-24 kV units USD 3,400-4,700, outdoor GIS RMU USD 6,000-7,100; Western-brand equipment typically 2-4x these FOB figures. Not a delivered Malaysian price.

costs.basis: MSEDCL Cost Data 2024-25, tender-cost column: 11 kV feeder bay INR 10.179 lakh (DPR estimate 14.342); 22 kV INR 12.106 (17.062); 33 kV INR 12.566 (17.712).
